production_rules: Render deterministic text and numbers from the canonical attendance business report only.
Do not use an AI-generated logo or any logo in this approved attendance layout.
Do not infer missing attendance minutes; null or unresolved values remain unconfirmed.
Morning and full-day reports use the locked 1600x1200 landscape visual system.
Daily layout must visually distinguish morning, afternoon and total work.
Teams captions stay concise; long operational notes live inside the image footer.
Any layout version, canvas size, slot identity, report identity, PNG dimension, or output hash failure blocks publication.
